activeRules.title: Centralize tuning constants
activeRules.instruction: 调参与机构参数集中存放并使用能表达用途或单位的名称；可以使用 enum、static final 或配置对象，不在逻辑代码中散落魔数。
activeRules.rationale: 20827 与 TeamChina 都集中表达参数；可复用的是语义、单位和集中维护，不是某个固定容器形式或机器人参数值。

activeRules.title: Explain mechanism intent in Chinese
activeRules.instruction: 为子系统、工具类和不明显的机构逻辑编写中文说明，重点解释用途、单位、有效范围和安全理由；不强制固定 Javadoc 或分节模板。
activeRules.rationale: 中文说明降低队内阅读成本；来源的注释格式并不统一，保留语义说明而不把分节格式当成安全要求。

activeRules.title: Centralize hardware in one Hardwares container
activeRules.instruction: 所有硬件引用集中在一个 Hardwares 容器类中，并按 Sensors、Motors、Servos 等职责分组；子系统接收该容器，不直接从 HardwareMap 获取设备。
activeRules.rationale: 统一初始化与命名，避免各子系统重复取硬件导致配置漂移。

activeRules.title: Configure motors for each mechanism
activeRules.instruction: 每个电机必须在机构初始化阶段明确配置方向、运行模式和 ZeroPowerBehavior；BRAKE 或 FLOAT 应按机构需要选择，不得无依据统一套用。
activeRules.rationale: 初始化需要明确方向、模式和零功率行为；TeamChina 的不同机构采用不同零功率行为，不能把统一 BRAKE 当作通用安全结论。

activeRules.title: Use semantic Java and season-scoped autonomous names
activeRules.instruction: 类使用 PascalCase，字段、方法和硬件配置名使用表达机构语义的 lowerCamelCase；不强制电机字段使用 m 前缀。本赛季自动类继续使用 <Side><Color>[Mini] 与 Base 抽象类的组合命名，不据此推断未来赛季路线。
activeRules.rationale: 语义化名称便于对应机构职责；取消强制 m 前缀，但保留经本赛季审批的自动类命名范围。

activeRules.title: Organize Driver Station and Dashboard telemetry
activeRules.instruction: 项目使用 FtcDashboard 时，通过 MultipleTelemetry 同时提供 Driver Station 与 Dashboard 遥测，并按机构或用途组织关键数据；不强制固定分隔符。
activeRules.rationale: 组合遥测同时服务驾驶员与调参者；仅在项目使用 Dashboard 时适用，数据组织比固定分隔符更重要。

activeRules.title: Keep build customizations in TeamCode
activeRules.instruction: Put legacy FTC SDK build customizations in TeamCode/build.gradle instead of build.common.gradle.
activeRules.rationale: The official SDK reserves build.common.gradle for changes delivered with SDK updates.

checks.note: SDK 保留 build.common.gradle；定制放进 TeamCode/build.gradle
SDK 保留 build.dependencies.gradle；依赖定制放进 TeamCode/build.gradle

activeRules.title: Pin a stable FTC Dashboard dependency
activeRules.instruction: Configure the official FTC Dashboard Maven repository and an exact stable dependency version for team projects.
activeRules.rationale: Dynamic and snapshot artifacts make competition builds non-reproducible.

checks.note: Dashboard 依赖必须钉住稳定版本，禁止 + / SNAPSHOT

activeRules.title: Verify dependencies through runtime
activeRules.instruction: Require successful Gradle Sync, local build, Robot Controller deployment, and a minimal runtime check after adding or changing an FTC library.
activeRules.rationale: Dependency resolution alone does not prove that the deployed robot app contains and can use the library.

activeRules.title: Pin the official FTC SDK release
activeRules.instruction: Build team projects from an identified FIRST FtcRobotController release or tag and record its FTC SDK version.
activeRules.rationale: A rolling branch can change and cannot reproduce a known robot build.

checks.note: FTC SDK 依赖必须钉住正式 release，禁止 + / SNAPSHOT

activeRules.title: Preserve release-supplied build tooling
activeRules.instruction: Use the Gradle Wrapper, Android Gradle Plugin, and Android build configuration supplied by the selected FTC SDK release unless FIRST documents a compatible change.
activeRules.rationale: Independent upgrades can make the FTC workspace incompatible with Android Studio or the robot controller runtime.

checks.note: 使用 SDK 发行版自带的 Gradle Wrapper，勿替换
使用 SDK 发行版自带的 Gradle Wrapper，勿替换
使用 SDK 发行版自带的 Wrapper 配置，勿替换

activeRules.title: Record FTC toolchain versions separately
activeRules.instruction: Record the Gradle JDK, Java source compatibility, Android SDK levels, and FTC SDK version as distinct values from their actual configuration locations.
activeRules.rationale: These similarly named versions control different parts of the build and are not interchangeable.

evidence.title: FtcRobotController v11.2 common Android build configuration
evidence.section: Android SDK, NDK, and Java compatibility

activeRules.title: Identify the exact goBILDA SKU
activeRules.instruction: Identify the exact goBILDA product and SKU before applying gear ratio, speed, torque, current, encoder, voltage, PWM, or travel specifications.
activeRules.rationale: Products in the same family can have different electrical and mechanical values.

evidence.title: 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor (19.2:1 Ratio, 24mm Length 8mm REX Shaft, 312 RPM, 3.3 - 5V Encoder)
evidence.product: 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor

activeRules.title: Separate stall and operating values
activeRules.instruction: Label no-load and stall specifications distinctly and do not present stall values as continuous operating ratings.
activeRules.rationale: The manufacturer publishes these as different operating conditions.

evidence.title: 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor (19.2:1 Ratio, 24mm Length 8mm REX Shaft, 312 RPM, 3.3 - 5V Encoder)
evidence.product: 5203 Series Yellow Jacket Planetary Gear Motor

activeRules.title: Record servo mode and PWM range
activeRules.instruction: Record exact servo SKU, mode, documented PWM range, voltage, direction, and travel before defining software endpoints or interpreting commands.
activeRules.rationale: A dual-mode servo interprets PWM as position in one mode and speed in continuous mode.

activeRules.title: Convert from output-shaft encoder resolution
activeRules.instruction: Use the documented output-shaft encoder resolution for the exact motor SKU and include every external transmission ratio when converting ticks to mechanism motion.
activeRules.rationale: Motor encoder counts describe the motor output shaft, not an arbitrary downstream mechanism.

activeRules.title: Back up before updating LimelightOS
activeRules.instruction: Back up Limelight pipelines and scripts before flashing or upgrading LimelightOS.
activeRules.rationale: The official quick start warns that an OS flash erases them.

activeRules.title: Check Limelight result validity
activeRules.instruction: Check that the latest Limelight result exists and is valid before using target or pose fields.
activeRules.rationale: The FTC API can return no usable target result.

checks.note: 新增的 Limelight 结果读取必须先做有效性检查（isValid）

activeRules.title: Configure camera pose for localization
activeRules.instruction: Configure camera pose relative to the robot before field localization and provide current robot orientation before consuming MegaTag 2 results.
activeRules.rationale: Field pose depends on camera extrinsics and MegaTag 2 fuses external orientation.

activeRules.title: Enforce a Limelight freshness policy
activeRules.instruction: Define and enforce a task-appropriate maximum result age before using Limelight data in closed-loop control or localization.
activeRules.rationale: A valid result can still be too old for the current control decision.

checks.note: 新增的 Limelight 闭环/定位读取必须先做新鲜度检查（时间戳）

activeRules.title: Synchronize pipeline-dependent reads
activeRules.instruction: Treat pipeline switching as asynchronous and verify the reported pipeline before consuming data that depends on the new pipeline.
activeRules.rationale: The pipeline switch call is fire-and-forget.

activeRules.title: Convert coordinate systems explicitly
activeRules.instruction: State source and destination coordinate systems and convert explicitly when exchanging poses between Pedro Pathing and FTC-standard or vision coordinates.
activeRules.rationale: Pedro documents a coordinate convention that differs from the FTC SDK standard.

activeRules.title: Validate localization before path following
activeRules.instruction: Configure and validate the selected localizer before relying on follower tuning or autonomous path accuracy.
activeRules.rationale: Follower control depends on accurate robot pose feedback.

activeRules.title: Tune values on the current robot
activeRules.instruction: Treat follower, drivetrain, and localizer values as measurements or tuning outputs for the current robot; do not copy another robot's values as validated configuration.
activeRules.rationale: Pedro constants include robot-specific mass, drivetrain, localizer, velocity, controller, and path-completion values.
